action: Customers and partners of Esco Optics: no action needed while unconfirmed. You may ask the company whether data you shared is affected, and be alert to unexpected emails that reference your dealings with it.
exec: Unverified extortion claim against a defence-supply manufacturer; this group has a record of fabricated listings.
plain: A criminal group says it stole data from optics maker Esco Optics and will publish it on November 25. The company has not confirmed this, and the group's past claims have sometimes been false.
summary: The group posted the precision-optics maker with a November 25 publication date and says no ransom was paid. The tracker warns that AOQIN listings have included unverified or fabricated claims, so treat this as unconfirmed.
title: AOQIN leak site lists Esco Optics
